summary: Temporal: parent-first and one-parent rule; every aspect-bearing event gets a parent; main event to DCT; vague present adverbs get no triple (main event depends-on DCT); corrected example. Aspect: -91 predicates are state plus modal; stative verbs stay state with 过; 已经 main predicate is performance. Implicit arguments: V1V2的N chain, :part-of only with written owner, no copied subjects, 其中 as :mod. No :wiki; no coref for modifier place names; inner and for nouns without 、. Examples added.

edits.new: **no `:wiki`** (do not add `:wiki` in Chinese documents; the gold has none; ignore the following note on it)

edits.anchor: the relation says where the **child** is relative to the **parent**:
edits.text: **In every triple `(A :rel B)`, A is the parent and B the child; every event and time node is the child of exactly one triple.**

edits.old: is also anchored to now: `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4t)`, then its event `(s4t :overlap s4e)`.
edits.new: gets no triple of its own (it stays `:temporal` in the graph). The sentence's main event attaches directly: `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4e)`. The sentence's other events attach to the main event: `(s4e :overlap s4e2)`.

edits.old: - Give no temporal parent to a copular predicate (`identity-91` for 是) or to a property used as a modifier.
edits.new:
- Give no temporal parent to `identity-91` or to a plain `:mod` word with no sense. Every other node with a sense and an `:aspect` gets a parent, normally `(main-event :overlap X)`. This includes an event inside a noun (查证-01) and the property under have-degree-91 (富-01).
- Anchor each sentence's main event to `document-creation-time` (`:before` if past). Do not anchor it to an event of an earlier sentence unless a word (然后, 之后, 同时) marks that relation.

edits.old: Example: `(document-creation-time :before s1f)`, then `(s1f :overlap s1s)` and `(s1k :contained s1f)`.
edits.new: Example (main event 发行 s1f, dependents 停止 s1s and 报导 s1b): `(document-creation-time :before s1f)`, `(s1f :overlap s1s)`, `(s1f :overlap s1b)`. The main event is always the parent (first element).

edits.text:
- `identity-91` and the other -91/-92 predicates are events too: give them `:aspect state` and a modal triple `(author :full-affirmative X)`. Only their temporal triple is left out.
- Stative verbs (拥有, 有, 是, 在, 属) stay `state` even with 过, 曾经 or 了.
- 已经 + a change-of-state verb as the main predicate (纸本已经停刊) is `performance`. `state` applies only to the 的-modifier form.

edits.old: - A version, edition or part of a publication or thing (X的纸本) → `:part-of`, not `:possessor`.
edits.new:
- A version, edition or part of a publication or thing (X的纸本) → `:part-of`, not `:possessor`, but only when X is written in the phrase. 网络版 alone gets no owner.
- 其中 → `:mod (其中)` on the noun it introduces, not `:part`.
- Nouns run together without 、 (奇闻轶事) form their own inner `and`; 、 separates the outer conjuncts.

edits.old: - Add an implicit or re-entrant argument only when the text expresses it.
edits.new:
- Add an implicit or re-entrant argument only when the text expresses it. Do not copy a subject or owner into another clause unless a word (自己, 其, a pronoun) refers to it.
- V1V2的N (已经停止发行的小报): N is `:ARG1-of` the inner verb, and the inner verb is `:ARG1-of` the outer verb. Do not make N an argument of the outer verb.

edits.anchor: - `(a :subset-of b)`: the entity or event a is a subset or part of b.
edits.text: - Link the document's participant chains. Do not link a country or place name used only as a modifier (`:place` of a noun, the 美国 of 美国历史) to another such mention.

edits.old: - Temporal (5.1): 目前停刊 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4t)` `(s4t :overlap s4e)`; no temporal triple for `identity-91`.
edits.new:
- Temporal (5.1): 目前纸本停刊，网络版继续发行 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4e)` `(s4e :overlap s4e2)`; no triple for 目前; no temporal triple for `identity-91`.
- Temporal (5.1): 富-01 under have-degree-91 → `(s5main :overlap s5f)`.
- V1V2的N (3): 已经停止发行的小报 → `(x / 小报 :ARG1-of (f / 发行-01 :ARG1-of (t / 停止-01 :mod (y / 已经) :aspect state) :aspect habitual))`.
- No invented owner (3): 发行网络版 → `(f / 发行-01 :ARG1 (w / 网络版))`.
- Inner and (3): 奇闻轶事、传奇与新闻 → `(a / and :op1 (a2 / and :op1 奇闻 :op2 轶事) :op2 传奇 :op3 新闻)`.
- Aspect (4.1): 曾经拥有过 → `:aspect state`; 纸本已经停刊 → `:aspect performance`; identity-91 → `:aspect state`.
